tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. Everything sits on paper; cards lift off it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised cards and forms. Separated from paper by tone and shadow-card, never a border.

tokens.name: inset
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: inputs, unselected chips, side panels, notes. ink-muted stays 5.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Decorative only: slider tracks, inactive step markers. Never text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on paper, surface and inset (13:1 or more).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, helper copy. 5.5:1 or more on every ground.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Lagoon. The only action colour: primary buttons, selected chips, links, focus rings, slider thumbs.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of primary fills and links.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary fills (7:1 or more).

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet primary tint: budget style chip, confirmations.

tokens.name: on-primary-soft
tokens.usage: Text on primary-soft.

tokens.name: laterite
tokens.usage: Accent that means local. Used in small doses: the local pick badge and its markers.

tokens.name: local-soft
tokens.usage: Local pick badge fill.

tokens.name: on-local-soft
tokens.usage: Local pick badge text (6.8:1 or more).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions only (delete account). Text and icons.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error message ground.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen: the destination or the question being asked.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Place names on itinerary cards, form group titles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: A quiet morning with the story of Lisbon tiles.
styles.usage: Card reasons, ledes, anything read as a sentence.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ije reuses your profile for every trip.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, badges, chip text at small size.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Sources, helper text, metadata. Always ink-muted.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Slot names on the canvas (morning, afternoon, evening). Set in capitals.

spacing.note: 8px scale only. No other values anywhere in the product.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap inside a group: chip to chip, label to input.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between related elements, input padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Gap between cards, inset panel padding.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between form groups.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Large card padding, gap between major groups.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections. Button and input height.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Page top and bottom margins on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-8
tokens.usage: Small marks: step indicators, swatches.

tokens.name: radius-16
tokens.usage: Inputs, inset panels, chat bubbles, badges.

tokens.name: radius-24
tokens.usage: Cards and forms.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, segmented controls.

shadow.note: Shadows replace borders. Keep them soft and tight.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Every raised card on paper.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Small raised controls on inset: the selected segment, a white button on an inset panel.
